The server URL must be a full http or https address.
The VPN network is not a valid IPv4 network prefix.

The network connection could not be prepared.
The server name could not be found. Check the address and your internet connection.

The request could not be sent.
The response was not received completely.
The response exceeded the configured size limit.
The server did not respond in time.
The server rejected the request as malformed.
The server rejected the credentials or the device time.

The server does not allow this request method.
The server rejected the request as too large.
The server rejected the request format.
The server is temporarily unavailable.
The server reported an internal error.
The server returned an unexpected HTTP status.
The server response failed validation.
The server response belongs to a different request.
The server response could not be authenticated.

No verified server time is available yet.

Another instance of the VPN core is already running.
The VPN core of the app is not running.
This action conflicts with the current state. Try again.
Cannot connect to the server
The server endpoint is not reachable or not valid.
Check the server URL and your internet connection, then try again.
Cannot verify the server
The server could not be verified with the configured server secret.
Check the configured server secret and the server settings.
Cannot connect to the server
The server rejected the configured access key.
Check the configured access key and try again.
Cannot start the VPN tunnel
The local VPN tunnel could not be started.
Check the VPN permission of the app and try again.
Cannot complete the connection
Communication with the server could not be completed.
Check the network and the server availability, then try again.
Server not responding
The request timed out and the connection was not confirmed. A communication failure does not by itself mean the secret is wrong.
Check your internet connection and the server address, then try again.
Cannot verify communication contracts
Communication contracts could not be verified. Check server compatibility.
Check server compatibility, then connect again.
Unable to verify status
The app has not received the current VPN status. Neither connection nor disconnection is confirmed.
Check status again.
Incompatible server version
The server uses a different major version than this app.
The server is reachable, but this app cannot communicate with it. Install a phpvpn app and server with the same major version.
Connection failed
The connection attempt failed.
Try again. If it keeps failing, check the configuration.
Disconnection not confirmed
The app did not confirm that the VPN was disconnected. The VPN may still be active.
Try to disconnect again or check the status.
Correct the reported issue, then verify again to start a new check.
Check the reported issue and the configuration file, then try the action again.
Restart the app. It restores the protection of its private folder at every start. Then inspect the file in the configuration editor.
Check SERVER_SECRET and ACCESS_KEYS for this virtual IP in the server file, or contact the server administrator.
Wait for the current operation to finish, then try again.
Open the setup wizard again.
Check the existing save receipt. Do not start another save automatically.
Choose Disconnect and continue to disconnect the VPN, then repeat the checks.
Choose another virtual IP, or correct the contract in the configuration editor before opening the setup wizard again.
Update the app, then open the setup wizard again.
The server is reachable, but this app cannot communicate with it. Install a phpvpn app and server with the same major version.
An unexpected error occurred.
